content.short: Fabwelt Studios focuses on creating an ecosystem composed of high-end blockchain games.
content.description: Fabwelt Studios is building the largest high-end gaming ecosystem on the blockchain, aimed at delivering premium Web3 experiences across multiple networks. The studio recently released H2O, an aquatic racing game that fuses high-speed competition with water navigation. In H2O, players tackle fluid, physics-driven courses, testing precision driving and on-chain strategy in an immersive environment. An August 2 launch date has been announced, with plans to expand on-chain gameplay as part of a broader cross-chain ecosystem across Polygon, Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Linea, and Immutable X.
